events.text: I'm about to repeat the same dance for Step 2 — make a sandbox dir, drop a `.python-version`, then run `uv venv` under the pin — for a couple of versions. Wrapping it in a tiny `scratch/hunt/probe_pin.sh` so I retype less, then driving it for the 3.12 case:

events.diff:
+#!/usr/bin/env bash
+set -eu
+pin="$1"; ver="$2"; req="${3:-}"
+dir="/tmp/uvpin-test/p-$ver"
+rm -rf "$dir" && mkdir -p "$dir"
+echo "$ver" > "$dir/.python-version"
+echo "--sanity: unprefixed find--"
+(cd "$dir" && uv python find)
+echo "--UV_PYTHON=$pin venv $req--"
+UV_PYTHON="$pin" uv venv $dir/v $req 2>&1 | head -1
+"$dir/v/bin/python" -V
